description: Cases excluded from the corrected benchmark (MSR 2027 revision, F1, 25 Nov 2026). A case stays only if its error is the same as in the submission (same git_diff, ci_logs and expected_fix, at most a different version number) and the CI actually turns red. experiments/benchmark.py skips every case listed here.
